milestones.title: Finish graph identity and mixed topology
milestones.exit: No public graph storage-row boundary; mixed edges preserve one identity, orientation and logical mutation semantics.

milestones.title: Bring durable embedding forward
milestones.exit: Facade create/open/commit/checkpoint/recover/verify work on format 2 only; canceled, committed and indeterminate outcomes have failure evidence.

milestones.title: Complete the semantic compiler
milestones.exit: One semantic→logical analysis route; no public ambiguous lower Value/GqlType bridge; diagnostics and generation dependencies survive lowering.

milestones.title: Deliver batch execution and native retrieval
milestones.exit: One production batch executor supports all selected families, native algorithms, vector retrieval, BM25/text and JSON; old row runtime is deleted.

milestones.title: Finish paths, indexes and measured performance
milestones.exit: Independent path oracles agree; composite/key enforcement is complete and incremental; scalar JSON paths are indexable; balanced performance decisions are recorded.

milestones.title: Qualify and release 2.0
milestones.exit: Owner-authorized release uses tested packages, accurate support/format statements and evidence-bounded GQL claims.

delivery_policy_changes.D-021: One coherent, reviewable behavior; touched-file and line counts are review signals, not binding allowlists or automatic stop triggers. Include necessary callers and tests. Replan material contract changes, not routine mechanical spread. Existing source-size/style gates stay unless separately changed.
delivery_policy_changes.D-022: Luna edits/tests; orchestrator coordinates integration and authorized Git/PR work. Use one independent read-only reviewer by default, with a second focused review for durability/concurrency/complex semantic risk when useful. Reviews/checks must still cover the current change; no separate manual revision bookkeeping. Tags/publication/permissions remain owner-authorized.
